exercises.name: Squat
exercises.convention: 0 deg = standing with straight knees; larger = deeper squat (knees bent). Average of both knees.
exercises.setup: Stand (or sit) side-on to the camera, 2 to 3 m away, with the working side toward the camera and your whole body in view.
exercises.description: Bend both knees and hips to lower the body, then stand back up.

form_checks.label: Forward trunk lean
form_checks.message: Keep your chest up, you are leaning too far forward

exercises.name: Standing knee flexion (hamstring curl)
exercises.convention: 0 deg = leg straight; larger = heel moving toward the buttock.
exercises.setup: Stand (or sit) side-on to the camera, 2 to 3 m away, with the working side toward the camera and your whole body in view.
exercises.description: Standing, bend one knee to bring the heel toward the buttock, then lower it.

form_checks.label: Thigh movement
form_checks.message: Keep your thigh still and move only the lower leg

form_checks.label: Trunk motion
form_checks.message: Keep your body still and move only the working joint

exercises.name: Seated knee extension
exercises.convention: Measured as knee flexion: starts about 90 deg (knee bent, seated) and falls toward 0 deg (leg straight).
exercises.setup: Sit side-on to the camera on a chair, 2 to 3 m away, with the working leg toward the camera and the whole leg visible.
exercises.description: Seated, straighten the knee until the leg is level, then lower it.

form_checks.label: Thigh movement
form_checks.message: Keep your thigh still and move only the lower leg

form_checks.label: Trunk motion
form_checks.message: Keep your body still and move only the working joint

exercises.name: Standing hip flexion (march)
exercises.convention: 0 deg = thigh in line with the trunk (standing); larger = knee lifted forward.
exercises.setup: Stand (or sit) side-on to the camera, 2 to 3 m away, with the working side toward the camera and your whole body in view.
exercises.description: Standing tall, lift one knee toward the chest, then lower it.

form_checks.label: Trunk motion
form_checks.message: Keep your body still and move only the working joint

exercises.name: Standing hip extension
exercises.convention: 0 deg = thigh in line with the trunk (standing); larger = leg swung backward behind the body.
exercises.setup: Stand (or sit) side-on to the camera, 2 to 3 m away, with the working side toward the camera and your whole body in view.
exercises.description: Standing tall, swing one straight leg backward without leaning, then return.

form_checks.label: Trunk motion
form_checks.message: Keep your body still and move only the working joint

exercises.name: Standing hip abduction
exercises.convention: 0 deg = leg straight down beside the other leg; larger = leg lifted out to the side.
exercises.setup: Face the camera, 2 to 3 m away, with your whole body in view and arms/legs clear of your body.
exercises.description: Standing tall, lift one straight leg out to the side, then lower it.

form_checks.label: Sideways trunk lean
form_checks.message: Stand tall, do not lean to the side

exercises.name: Elbow flexion (bicep curl)
exercises.convention: 0 deg = arm straight; larger = elbow more bent (hand toward the shoulder).
exercises.setup: Stand (or sit) side-on to the camera, 2 to 3 m away, with the working side toward the camera and your whole body in view.
exercises.description: With the upper arm still at your side, bend the elbow to bring the hand to the shoulder.

form_checks.label: Upper arm movement
form_checks.message: Keep your upper arm still next to your body

form_checks.label: Trunk motion
form_checks.message: Keep your body still and move only the working joint

exercises.name: Elbow extension (triceps)
exercises.convention: Measured as elbow flexion: starts about 90 deg (elbow bent) and falls toward 0 deg (arm straight).
exercises.setup: Stand (or sit) side-on to the camera, 2 to 3 m away, with the working side toward the camera and your whole body in view.
exercises.description: Starting with the elbow bent at 90 degrees, straighten the arm fully, then bend it again.

form_checks.label: Upper arm movement
form_checks.message: Keep your upper arm still next to your body

form_checks.label: Trunk motion
form_checks.message: Keep your body still and move only the working joint

exercises.name: Shoulder flexion (forward raise)
exercises.convention: 0 deg = arm hanging beside the trunk; 90 deg = arm horizontal in front; 180 deg = overhead.
exercises.setup: Stand (or sit) side-on to the camera, 2 to 3 m away, with the working side toward the camera and your whole body in view.
exercises.description: Raise the straight arm forward and up, then lower it slowly.

form_checks.label: Trunk motion
form_checks.message: Keep your body still and move only the working joint

exercises.name: Shoulder extension
exercises.convention: 0 deg = arm hanging beside the trunk; larger = arm swung backward behind the body.
exercises.setup: Stand (or sit) side-on to the camera, 2 to 3 m away, with the working side toward the camera and your whole body in view.
exercises.description: With a straight arm, swing it backward behind the body without leaning, then return.

form_checks.label: Trunk motion
form_checks.message: Keep your body still and move only the working joint

exercises.name: Shoulder abduction (lateral raise)
exercises.convention: 0 deg = arm hanging beside the trunk; 90 deg = arm horizontal out to the side; 180 deg = overhead.
exercises.setup: Face the camera, 2 to 3 m away, with your whole body in view and arms/legs clear of your body.
exercises.description: Raise the straight arm out to the side and up, then lower it slowly.

form_checks.label: Sideways trunk lean
form_checks.message: Stand tall, do not lean to the side
